correctness.rationale: The proof covers arbitrary positive real budgets and cost coefficients and all finite heterogeneous clique bouquets. Strict convexity on connected weighted Laplacians and injective edge representation make the global optimum unique; symmetries force classwise weights without restricting the original domain. Grounded Laplacian blocks invert exactly and give the Kirchhoff-index formula, which is independently checked against rational pair resistances. Lagrange multiplier KKT has exhaustive interior/boundary regimes, including when the transformed coefficient alpha is negative; the directional derivative gives the exact threshold (N-1)d < 2Nc. The resulting positive spokes, optional nonnegative rims, global budget and S²/B optimum follow algebraically. The standard-library verifier checks 8 exact-rational direct-Laplacian cases (170 pair entries), 8 cost regimes and 256 feasible perturbations, as corroboration only.

Actual published mathematical record searches returned graph-related but nonimplicative mathematical findings. This is best-knowledge originality, not a priority certificate.

value.rationale: The full individual-edge global Kirchhoff-index conductance design is a recognized network optimization problem, with a natural finite family of hub-connected dense communities. Cost heterogeneity creates a real, sharp phase transition between retaining and deleting entire internal edge classes. The unexpected N-only cost threshold, exact formulas for all weights and optimal resistance, and simultaneous active/inactive petals are substantial and reusable structural results, not a renaming or a fixed-parameter computation; method and mathematical scope are explicit.
